features: Silicone Ice Cube Tray: The ice cube trays are made of good silicone, which can be used for dishwasher, refrigerator, freezer and microwave.

Ice Trays Set: This is a set of 2 pack silicone ice cube trays for freezer, 15 cavities each, allowing you to make square ice cubes(1.25 inches) , and the ice cube tray are moderate in size and can cool the drink quickly.

Easy to Remove: Our silicone ice cube tray is soft, and you can easy to remove the ice cubes out. (Simply let stand for 1 minute, or rinse the bottom silicone with water to remove the ice cubes faster. Never use brute force to take ice, which will cause the large ice cube tray for whiskey cracked.)
Suitable for Various Drinks: These ice cube trays for freezer are suitable for freezing 1 ounce servings of homemade pureed, sauces, or as molds for a cubed fudge or candy.
